_comment: requirement_id -> documents (Licenses, Permits, Certificates, Other) the entry packet must contain. BASE applies to every shipment. Matching against shipment.documents_on_file is a loose substring match on the part before ', '.
BASE: Bill of lading or air waybill, transport document
ISF 10+2 filing confirmation, ocean shipments only
FDA_PRIOR_NOTICE: FDA Prior Notice confirmation number, PNC, filed before arrival
Foreign manufacturer FDA Food Facility Registration number
FDA_FSVP: FSVP importer name, email and DUNS number
FDA_FACILITY_REG: Foreign manufacturer FDA Food Facility Registration number
NOAA_SIMP: IFTP, International Fisheries Trade Permit number
SIMP harvest and landing data record, retained for audit
CPSC_CPC: Third-party test report, ASTM F963, CPSC-accepted laboratory
EPA_ENGINE_3520_21: EPA Form 3520-21, nonroad engine import declaration
FCC_SDOC: FCC Supplier's Declaration of Conformity, 47 CFR 2.906
DOE_CERT: DOE compliance certification report, Compliance Certification Management System
FDA_CERAMICWARE: Ceramicware lead and cadmium leach test certificate, food-contact use
CBP_ADCVD_CHECK: AD/CVD scope determination memo, case numbers and cash deposit rate
